IT Market Capacity in UAE

Not all people think about the UAE as an IT destination for their business projects, but in fact it is a pretty appealing one. That is why we want to talk a bit more about the IT market capabilities in the UAE to show you more of its attractive traits and maybe help you to find the best IT services there. And the main helper in this case is, of course, statistics, that can show us the core advantages software development UAE can suggest to you. So, let’s take a deep breath and dive into the UAE IT market possibilities for a while to learn more about it.

  • First things first we need to mention about are the overall numbers that shows us the wideness of the IT market in UAE. Thus, according to the statistics, there are 262k of IT professionals in the whole UAE. Such a number reflects the demand at the tech field existing there that causes consecutive growth of specialists’ quantity.
  • What is more, it also entails growth of the IT companies number in which all these specialists can be engaged. In such a way, there are 32k of IT companies in the UAE! Stunning number, isn’t it? And it especially is as it means that your ability to find a suitable one is increasing with it. So, if you are looking for a software developer company in UAE there is a long list to choose from!
  • Besides, there are also some numbers that show us the economical value of the IT market in UAE. Thus, the IT industry growth rate in UAE in the following five years is predicted to be 7.45%, that means a significant increase of the market volume. It shows us that it is a modern and fastly developing one, that makes it a better place for your business and IT outsourcing UAE.
  • Talking about the outsourcing to UAE, it is also important to note about the tech export value that counts 2.9 billion for now. It means that services export is a significant part of the overall tech field in UAE. That is why you may easily find the best IT outsourcing company in UAE.
  • Moreover, the IT market in UAE is presented with a diversity of services and experts. You can easily find services there based on such popular and widely spreaded programming languages as Python, Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and others!

Differences at IT Market in UAE by Cities

So, we have already talked about the general IT market traits in UAE, but there is also a difference depending on the city you choose. That is why we analyzed the IT market in the top five UAE cities and are ready to tell you about our observations. Hence, below you can read more about each city and its peculiarities in the tech field. 

  • Dubai. The first city we want to talk about is Dubai, the most popular city in the UAE, an administrative center of the emirate. It can be honestly named an important trade and financial center in the UAE and even in the whole region. Surely, you know a lot about this city and have seen at least once its beautiful, overwhelming architecture. It all shows very well that Dubai is a modern tech hub.

That is why there are a lot of IT outsourcing companies in Dubai and specialists with different specializations. It raises the freelance offers, so that you can easily hire a freelance PHP developer in Dubai, for example. The average salary of a software developer in Dubai is $5,900 per month, that is a fair price for the software developer in UAE. 

  • Abu Dhabi. The next city is Abu Dhabi, the capital of UAE. It is a big city and an important business center in the country. Also, it is a well developed one, that is reflected in the city’s appearance, its modern architecture and developed trade system. And, it is not a surprise that it is also a significant player in the IT market in UAE.

As a result, there are a great number of IT professionals and IT outsourcing companies in Abu Dhabi. The average salary of a software developer there is $4,000 per month. As you can see, it can be a good and cost-effective alternative to IT outsourcing in Dubai, as the average IT developers’ salary there is significantly lower, while the advantages are the same.

  • Sharjah. One more city we want to emphasize is Sharjah, which is also named the cultural capital of the UAE. It is comparatively more conservative, and is also mirrored in the city’s structure and main sights. Thus, this city is especially good for excursions to learn more about the history and culture of the country, as there are plenty of preserved historical places and museums.

But, besides that, Sharjah is also a modern rapidly developing city, so the IT industry is also a major one here. Hence, it is presented with a pretty large number of specialists. The average salary of a software developer in Sharjah is $3,400 per month. So, if hiring a developer in Abu Dhabi or Dubai is not for your budget, then Sharjah is a great decision for you. 

  • Al Ain. Fourth city in our list and fourth city for the population factor in the UAE is Al Ain. It is a huge city situated not so far from the UAE capital, Abu Dhabi. There is an airport there, developed infrastructure with parks, museums, and historical places. Moreover, there is a university there that makes it a hub for young specialists.

The IT field is also presented there with the relatively high number of professionals engaged in this sphere. The average salary of a software developer in Al Ain is $5,100 per month. So, if you have not found an IT outsourcing company in Dubai, then try to look in Al Ain.

  • Ajman. The last city to mention in our list is Ajman. It is an administrative center and one more big city in the UAE. It is located near Sharjah and connecting with it and Dubai makes an agglomeration. It makes Ajman an important player in the UAE IT market. 

Thus, there are plenty of IT specialists there. The average salary of a software developer in Ajman is $3,000 per month. You can see that it is noticeably lower than in other UAE cities. That is why it is a good place to look for IT outsourcing companies in UAE if you have a tight budget or just do not want to spend too much money on some project.

How Much Does It Cost to Hire Developers in UAE?

The salary of a software developer in the UAE may vary depending not only on the location, but also on the experience and knowledge a specialist has. Thus, there are three main levels according to which all experts can be divided. The average salary of a software developer in UAE for the Junior level is $1,800 per month, for the Middle is $4,000 per month and for the Senior is $6,600 per month.

Besides, the salary may also vary depending on the specializations and skills a developer has. So, check the list below to learn more about the average monthly salaries in UAE for different tech specializations.

  • A Laravel dedicated developer in Dubai makes nearly $2,500 per month on average.
  • PHP developer salary in UAE is about $1,600 per month on average.
  • A JavaScript developer in Dubai makes $4,300 per month.
  • Web developers in Abu Dhabi have an average salary of nearly $2,000 per month.

As you can see, the difference is pretty noticeable, but the UAE is still a great place for the IT field. So, you can find an IT outsourcing agency in Dubai or hire a developer Abu Dhabi UAE or look for a specialist in another city if these two are too expensive for you. The UAE gives you vast opportunities for IT outsourcing, no matter which goals and capacities you have!

FAQs

  • Is the UAE a good place for hiring IT specialists?

The UAE can be definitely named one of the best places in the IT field, and for IT outsourcing in particular. It is also proved by the IT market capacity in the UAE and its growth, especially growth predicted for the near five years. So, if you are looking for IT specialists in the UAE, you can be reassured that you have chosen a good country for it.

  • Which specializations are most in demand at the IT market in the UAE?

The IT market in the UAE is notable by the diversity of various specializations presented, but, of course, there are some that are the most popular. Thus, specialists working with the widely spreaded programming languages like Python, .Net, PHP, JavaScript, CSS are on demand.

  • What is the average salary for a software developer in the UAE?

Talking about the average salary for a software developer in the UAE, it is hard to name one exact number as there are a lot of factors influencing it. Thus, the price will vary, depending on the location, skills and experience of the developer. But the most real average number for an IT specialist in the UAE is about $3000 per month.

  • Which cities are the best for IT outsourcing in the UAE?

Location is an important factor in the hiring process that affects the cost and hiring abilities. That is why we can highlight the best cities for IT outsourcing in the UAE, that suggests the biggest number of IT specialists and wider range of specializations. Thus, there are such cities as Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Al Ain, Ajman.

  • How can I benefit from hiring an IT specialist in the UAE?

Hiring IT resources in the UAE can be beneficial for you, as there are a large number of IT professionals with various specializations, so that it will be easy to find a suitable one. What is more, there is comparatively low salaries and wide scale of the cost variability, that makes UAE IT market suitable for nearly everyone.
